stories.title: Miami climbs to 1, BYU to 2 after chaotic week shakes up AP poll
stories.summary: Miami climbed to the No. 1 spot in the AP Top 25 for the first time since 2002 while BYU's No. 2 ranking is its highest since 1984.

stories.title: Doubs hurt on lengthy TD catch, among several Patriots to exit
stories.summary: WR Romeo Doubs was hurt after diving to haul in a 42-yard touchdown pass from Drake Maye with 4:10 remaining in the first quarter.

stories.title: Falcons rookie LB Daniels immobilized, carted off after tackle vs. Bears
stories.summary: Kendal Daniels is alert and has movement in all his extremities, the Falcons said Sunday, after he injured his neck on a tackle attempt vs. the Bears.

stories.title: Big 12 admits error in Notre Dame-BYU ending, says Irish had 1 second left
stories.summary: The Big 12 said officials incorrectly ended Saturday night's game between BYU and Notre Dame and that the Irish should have had another second on the clock to run a final play.

stories.title: Source: FSU loses top RB Kromah for season with ankle injury
stories.summary: Florida State running back Ousmane Kromah will miss the rest of the season after injuring his left ankle in Saturday's double-overtime loss to Miami.
